Method of Attack: PowerShell-based ransomware that encrypts the computer without downloading additional components
Distributed via spam emails with malicious Word document attachments containing macros that execute PowerShell commands
PowerShell script downloads JasperLoader malware downloader which installs other malware and then encrypts files
Deletes Shadow Volume Copies, Windows backups, disables Windows recovery environment
Encrypts files appending .FTCODE extension and creates ransom notes
Uses a killswitch file to prevent encryption if present
Sends encryption key to attacker’s command and control server
Impacted Systems: Windows 7 and later (PowerShell installed by default)
Windows XP (less impacted due to lack of PowerShell)
Attack Vector: Spam emails with malicious Word document attachments targeting Italian users
